title: It’s Worse
caption: It’s Worse (V)
game_text: Use 1 Force to ▼ a pit. OR At end of your deploy phase, target a non-frozen captive at a site; captive is released and relocated to a related pit you do not occupy. OR During an attack, cancel a just drawn weapon destiny.

notes: Group: Everything else. Not unique. Normal bottom-half slip (756×454): banner USED INTERRUPT (printed card is a LOST INTERRUPT); game text 5 lines; ▼ where the stub expands 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'; 'OR' as printed (no line breaks before OR). No icon column, no credits. Curly ’ in title/caption. Printed text was 'If It Could Be Worse was just played, it is canceled and you may use X Force to raise damage against opponent by X amount. OR If opponent just lost Force from a battle, play to increase loss by 1 Force.' Lore matches the wiki and the scan. Premiere: no expansion ring. Base scan 350 px; copyright 1995 (legible).
